title: Understanding Orthogonality
text: In linear algebra, two vectors are orthogonal if their dot product is zero. This means they are perpendicular to each other in the vector space.

title: Intercept Vector
text: The intercept vector is a vector of ones, denoted as $$1$$, which is often used in regression models to account for the bias term.

title: Residuals in OLS
text: The residuals in an OLS model are the differences between the true outcomes Y and the predicted outcomes \hat{Y}.

title: Dot Product of Intercept and Residuals
text: Calculate the dot product of the intercept vector $$1$$ and the residuals Y-\hat{Y}. What should this value be for them to be orthogonal?

title: Conclusion
text: If the dot product of two vectors is zero, they are orthogonal. Therefore, the intercept vector $$1$$ is orthogonal to the residuals Y-\hat{Y}.
